title: Foreign Selling Persisted. The Rebound Failed.
deck: Primary IDX data show five selling days and a narrow path to recovery.
description: IHSG Weekly Market Update, 21-25 September 2026: IDX foreign flows, weekly sectors, index movers and BI JISDOR with transparent calculations.

blocks.text: The IHSG fell 3.09% while IDX statistics recorded Rp3.16tn of foreign net selling across all five sessions. Thursday alone contributed Rp1.49tn of that total. Wednesday's 97.868-point rebound was followed by a 133.020-point decline through Friday. The price recovery lacked flow confirmation.

JISDOR rose 0.97% between the two Fridays, increasing the currency hurdle for an unhedged dollar investor. The reference-rate timing differs from the equity close, so this is an indicative comparison rather than an executable return.

blocks.label: 02 / FOREIGN FLOW
blocks.title: Foreign selling persisted across all five sessions
blocks.note: Daily net foreign stock purchases, Rp bn. The weekly figure combines stock-trading venues.

sections.title: Ten sectors declined for the week

blocks.text: Only consumer cyclicals finished positive, by 0.02%. Industrials fell 5.48%, infrastructure 4.10% and technology 3.96%. Price performance establishes where risk was borne; it does not identify foreign accumulation.

sections.title: Three names drove a third of the index loss

blocks.text: IDX's index-mover table attributes 66.10 negative IHSG points to BYAN, BBRI and BMRI combined, against the index's net 199.267-point fall. This is roughly one-third of the net decline before gains elsewhere offset losses.

sections.title: Make the recovery earn its credibility

blocks.label: Tactical stance
blocks.text: Defensive tilt; conditional, staged accumulation. Add risk only as price recovery gains sector participation and daily foreign selling eases. For unhedged dollar investors, test the FX hurdle against an executable rate before acting.
Monitoring references and scenarios are not statistically validated support or resistance and carry no assigned probabilities.

method: Returns are price returns. Rp bn means billion rupiah; Rp tn means trillion rupiah. IDX classifies foreign investors by the domicile entered into its trading system, not necessarily ultimate beneficial ownership. The JISDOR-based USD return excludes dividends, fees, taxes, hedging and tracking costs.
